## 7. AI Agent Test Prompts

### For browser-use Agent

```
OBJECTIVE: Validate note switching with custom blocks works

STEPS:
1. Navigate to http://localhost:3000/notes
2. Create 3 notes with different custom blocks:
   - Note A: Insert ColumnBlock using /column command
   - Note B: Insert SyncedBlock using /sync command
   - Note C: Insert ReferenceBlock using /reference command
3. Switch between notes 5 times in sequence: A→B→C→A→B
4. Verify no console errors appear
5. Verify all blocks render correctly after switching
6. Take screenshots after each switch

PASS CRITERIA:
- All notes switch without errors
- No "Cannot find node position" error in console
- All block types visible and interactive

FAIL CRITERIA:
- Any JavaScript error in console
- White screen or error boundary displayed
- Block content missing after switch
```

### For computer-use Agent

```
OBJECTIVE: Test cross-device responsiveness

SETUP:
- Resize browser window to mobile dimensions (393x852)

STEPS:
1. Navigate to http://localhost:3000
2. Verify bottom navigation appears (Notes | Search | AI)
3. Navigate to Notes workspace
4. Create a note with ColumnBlock
5. Verify ColumnBlock stacks columns vertically
6. Navigate to /ide/{projectId}
7. Verify redirect to Notes with explanation message

PASS CRITERIA:
- Mobile layout renders correctly
- Touch targets >= 44x44px
- IDE properly blocks mobile access
```
